problem.title: Successful Pairs of Spells and Potions
problem.problemStatement: Given arrays of spells and potions along with a success threshold, determine for each spell the number of potions that form a successful pair.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N, M, and Success. • Second line contains N spell values. • Third line contains M potion values.
problem.output: Print the number of successful pairs for each spell.
